summary: Independent Q6 inspection finds a real Django dual-AZ checkout HA skeleton with coupled defects across writer fencing, AZ-B write affinity, sticky pins, seq-gated reads, capture idempotency, standby sync, and /readyz versus /healthz. That core is non-toy and entrypoint-reachable. It fails large_system_strict on honest substantive scale: solver-visible Python excluding the offline seed generator sits at 3011 LOC (floor+11), while ~537 LOC of never-referenced top-level helpers plus discard-touch `_ = (...)` wiring inflate reachability without changing starter behavior. Seed/standby SQL (~150k+ lines each) is data volume, not runtime logic, and must not be counted. After discounting dead helper padding and excluding seed dumps, substantive reachable runtime/config is below the 3000 floor and PADDING_RISK is HIGH.

evidence.observation: Q6 requires entrypoint tracing, reachability, module diversity, coupling, toy/padding inspection, ~25% removal test, and data-vs-logic separation. For large_system_strict, PASS needs >=3000 substantive reachable solver-visible runtime/config LOC and no HIGH toy/padding risk. Complexity Governor PASS is not sufficient.

Count only implementation that materially participates in the claimed operational system. Reject duplicated, dead, unreachable, or unnecessary abstractions used to approach the 3000 floor. Seed/data volume is not authored code complexity.

Software/Systems task with artifacts [/app/ha], separate verifier, public network, workdir /app/ha. Session/controller context treats the work package as large_system_strict; task.toml itself does not waive the strict LOC floor.
Public HTTP entrypoints expose healthz/readyz plus place/pay/confirmation checkout APIs, binding checkout.views and controlplane.views into the live WSGI surface.
Operator workflows cutover, sync_standby, and dump_failover are real manage.py commands that reach fencing, replica apply, cutover FSM, and failover-status reporting.
Lab bootstrap loads schema.sql plus seed/standby_seed into primary/standby sqlite files; establishes durable dual-file state consumed by Django DATABASES.

ShopdeskRouter couples write_policy dispositions, AZ_WRITE_AFFINITY leftover divert, sticky pins, and replica lag eligibility. Starter still forces AZ-B writes to replica even after policy consultation.

Place/capture paths exercise attempt validation, inventory reservation, fence assert_can_write, LSN bumps, sticky pins, and fulfill capture effects—material multi-module branching rather than constant-output shells.

Largest controlplane module (~262 substantive lines). Router uses build_snapshot/decide_write_alias/alias_for_disposition/merge_fence_views, but multiple top-level helpers (demote_non_owners, explain_write_path, write_alias_or_raise, describe_nodes, nodes_from_config, choose_sole_writer, etc.) have zero cross-module references.

Documents shared pin backend contract, but sessions.py only uses pin_cache_key/classify_store/forbidden_pin_locations. set_pin/get_pin (~49 lines) are never called; starter pins still go through ShopSession + locmem.

failover_status builds optimistic dump output while assigning live helper results into `_ = (...)` throwaways (summarize_window, standby_only_refs, probe_codes, validate_status_object, duplicate_effect_count). That is reachability theater: helpers are touched without driving returned behavior.
apply_standby performs real sqlite table copy with a defective cutoff and lease copy, but also discard-touches default_sync_plan/should_block_writable_lease_copy via `_ = (...)`.
Offline seed generator (~426 substantive lines) is not imported by manage.py, WSGI, router, checkout, or operator commands. It must not count toward reachable runtime LOC.

Approximately 154k lines / multi-thousand order rows. Representative stateful data for HA reasoning, but counting it as substantive production logic would be the seed.sql LOC inflation the packet warns against.
About 157 non-comment SQL lines defining catalogs, shoppers, inventory, checkout, fulfill, and HA fence/watermark tables. Legitimate runtime/config surface consumed by start-lab and Django models.

Incident handoff cites AZ-B posting to replica, confirmation drift, duplicate capture attempts, and writable lease copy onto standby—symptoms that map to reachable router/fencing/sessions/fulfill/replica code paths.

Non-comment Python excluding generate_seed.py totals 3011. Import-graph reachability from urls/wsgi/manage commands covers essentially all app modules except generate_seed and package boilerplate. Dead never-referenced top-level helpers alone measure ~537 LOC across write_policy, pin_contract, watermark_journal, ha_metrics, readiness_policy, replica_plan, cutover_fsm, and siblings.

findings.criterion: large_system_strict requires >=3000 substantive reachable solver-visible runtime/config LOC after excluding data dumps, offline generators, and non-participating padding
findings.why_it_matters: Raw python_loc 3011 only clears the floor if nearly every helper line is treated as substantive. Discounting ~537 LOC of never-referenced helpers (and keeping seed.sql out of the count) leaves honest substantive runtime/config below 3000 even after adding schema.sql, ha.json, and start-lab.
findings.minimal_remediation: Add materially coupled, entrypoint-driven domain/runtime logic (or wire existing dead contract helpers into live place/pay/readyz/cutover/sync/dump paths so they change observable behavior), then re-inventory. Do not grow seed.sql to manufacture LOC.
findings.regression_risk: Expanding unused helper catalogs without wiring them would re-create the same floor-hugging failure mode.

findings.criterion: Production authenticity forbids unnecessary abstractions and code whose removal would not materially change production behavior; reachability must be operational, not theatrical
findings.why_it_matters: The package sits at exactly 3011 Python LOC while carrying dozens of never-called helpers and `_ = (helper(...), ...)` discard sites. Removing roughly that helper band (~25% of several large controlplane files) would leave starter place/pay/readyz/cutover behavior largely intact, failing the removal test and establishing HIGH padding risk.
findings.minimal_remediation: Either delete non-participating helper surface or make those helpers authoritative for router/sessions/readyz/dump/replica decisions so discarding them breaks invariants.
findings.regression_risk: Deleting helpers that the intended repair must call could shrink the legitimate policy vocabulary; prefer wiring over blind deletion when the helper encodes a required invariant.

findings.criterion: Subsystem responsibilities should differ materially rather than cloning one decision into parallel modules for scale
findings.why_it_matters: accepting_checkout / writer / seq_gap / pins / repeat-capture checks are restated across readiness_policy, ha_metrics, and status_schema. Some overlap is normal for dump versus HTTP, but the parallel catalogs add LOC without adding a new operational plane.
findings.minimal_remediation: Consolidate on one authoritative readiness composition used by both /readyz and dump_failover, and keep secondary modules as thin adapters.
findings.regression_risk: Low if a single composition function remains shared; watch dump schema field parity.

Optional deepening of checkout/fulfill/inventory runtime paths only when it adds coupled operational behavior
Re-run independent substantive LOC inventory after revision; exclude seed.sql/standby_seed.sql and sql/generate_seed.py from runtime LOC
do_not_change: Do not count seed.sql or standby_seed.sql toward substantive runtime/config LOC
Do not treat validate_task_complexity.py PASS or recorded python_loc 3011 as sufficient Q6 evidence
Do not modify tests/, solution/, or instruction.md on the strength of this Q6 result alone

next_gate: Environment Builder revises solver-visible runtime logic to clear an honest >=3000 substantive reachable LOC floor with PADDING_RISK no higher than MEDIUM, then re-issue Q6 on the new task commit/scope hash.

role_output.SUBSTANTIVE_LOC_ASSESSMENT: Independent inventory: non-comment Python excluding offline sql/generate_seed.py = 3011 (matches packet python_loc). Import reachability from WSGI urls and manage.py commands covers the Django app modules. Never-referenced top-level helpers alone ≈537 LOC; reports/replica discard-touch additional policy APIs without consuming results. schema.sql + ha.json + start-lab add ~180 legitimate config/ops lines. seed.sql/standby_seed.sql are large deterministic datasets and are excluded. Honest substantive reachable runtime/config after removing non-participating helper padding is approximately 2500–2800—below the large_system_strict >=3000 floor. The codebase is floor-hugging rather than naturally large.

PARTIAL_FIX_TRAPS: Fixing DATABASES['default'] alone leaves AZ-B affinity diverting POSTs to replica.
Making /healthz green without composing writer count, seq gap, shared pins, and repeat captures still admits unsafe traffic via /readyz.
Moving pins out of django_session without a shared pins backend still drops sticky reads across AZ hops.
Syncing standby rows while copying a writable fence lease recreates double-writer.
Capturing payments without attempt_id-scoped side-effect uniqueness still duplicates webhook rows on retry.
Gating replica reads on row counts instead of watermark LSN still serves stale confirmation during lag.
role_output.REMOVAL_TEST: Removing ~25% of solver-visible Python can target the never-referenced helper band in write_policy, pin_contract, watermark_journal, ha_metrics, readiness_policy, replica_plan, and cutover_fsm (~537 LOC) plus discard-touched adapters. Starter place/pay/confirmation, defective AZ-B writes, session pins, cutoff sync, and optimistic dump/readyz behavior would largely survive. By contrast, removing router/fencing/checkout.services/fulfill/sessions would collapse the claimed HA system. Because a large removable fraction is non-behavioral padding near the 3010 floor, the system is not yet substantively large under large_system_strict.
REQUIRED_CHANGES: Grow or wire substantive reachable runtime/config logic until an honest inventory is >=3000 without seed.sql or generate_seed.py.
Eliminate HIGH padding: remove or operationally bind dead helpers; replace `_ = (helper(...))` theater with authoritative use.
Keep module diversity and coupling; deepen behavior rather than cloning readiness catalogs or inflating SQL seeds.
